cast.design: A composed, grounded woman in her early fifties with a Nairobi Kenyan English accent, a low, warm voice, quietly certain, used to command.
cast.style: A ship's captain on the broadcast: quick, clipped and assertive. She snaps each order out at pace, with no pauses between sentences, firm and urgent, expecting to be obeyed at once. Commanding, not theatrical.
cast.sample: General quarters, general quarters. Raider closing to starboard. All hands, man your battle stations. Close all pressure doors.
